info.title: GameNode API
info.description:
API docs for the videogame catalog system GameNode.

Built with love by the GameNode team.

uid.description:
Corresponds to the game id on the target source (see GameExternalGameCategory).
It's called uid, not uuid.

origin.description: Who owns this row: the IGDB catalog sync, a bulk fill job or a moderator.

id.description: Should be mapped to the IGDB ID of the game.

source.description: Oh dear maintainer, please forgive me for using transient fields.

ownedPlatforms.description: The platforms on which the user owns the game.

defaultEntryStatus.description: The default status for collection entries added to this collection.

userId.description:
Shareable string ID

Same as the Better Auth user id.

items.description: Items to acknowledge as read (up to 100)

userId.description: Should be the same as the profile's UserId

levelUpExpCost.description: Threshold XP to hit the next user-level

expMultiplier.description: The multiplier to apply to all exp gains

follower.description: User that is following another user.

followerUserId.description: User that is following another user.

externalAchievementId.description:
The ID of the achievement in the external platform (e.g., Steam achievement ID).
Normalized to a string to accommodate various formats across platforms.

hasCompletedAllAchievements.description:
If the user has obtained all achievements for the game
(including obtained achievements not related to this specific activity), this is set to true.
This value may be outdated if a game update/DLC adds new achievements, but
for activity purposes it is sufficient.

hasObtainedPlatinumTrophy.description:
Exclusive to PlayStation games: if the user has obtained the platinum trophy for the game
This will only be true if the platinum trophy is featured in the list of obtained achievements
for this specific activity.

externalGame.description:
The related external game the achievements were obtained for.
All obtained achievements for this activity should be related to this specific external game, but this is not enforced on the database level.

obtainedGameAchievements.description:
Game achievements obtained by the user for this activity.
This reads as 'achievements obtained since last check' and usually only includes
one or more achievements for related to a single game, since processing is done on a per-game basis.

level.description: 1-based position of this tier in its definition.

obtainedCount.description: Number of profiles that obtained this tier, used for rarity.

metric.description: Key of a metric registered in achievement-metrics.ts

profile.description: The associated profile with this Activity (e.g. user who performed an action)

totalItems.description: Total number of items available for the current query

totalPages.description: Total number of pages available for the current query

hasNextPage.description: If this query allows for a next page

uid.description:
Corresponds to the game id on the target source (see GameExternalGameCategory).
It's called uid, not uuid.

origin.description: Who owns this row: the IGDB catalog sync, a bulk fill job or a moderator.

name.description: Glyph name (kebab-case) or name of an existing icon in public/icons

rarity.description: Fraction (0-1) of profiles that obtained this tier. May be up to one hour stale.

isHidden.description: Hidden achievements not obtained by the target user have name, description, metric, criteria and icon set to null

startsAt.description: Effective time window (the event's, when the achievement belongs to one)

tier.description: Highest obtained tier level, 0 when none

nextThreshold.description: Threshold of the next tier, null when every tier is obtained

featuredAchievementIds.description:
Obtained achievements ids passed here will be marked as featured, while ids not present will be automatically
marked not featured.

id.description: Stable slug, also used as the achievement id

metric.description: Key of a metric listed by GET /achievements/admin/metrics

tiers.description: Tiers in ascending threshold order. After publishing, existing tiers must be resent unchanged and new ones appended.

Indicates whether the platinum trophy has been obtained for the game.
This is often a key indicator of 100% completion in many games.

globalPercentage.description: Global percentage of users that own this achievement (essentially represents rarity).

platformIds.description:
Related GamePlatform references.

isImporterViable.description:
If this connection can be used by the importer system to import games
e.g.: Steam, PSN

isImporterWatchViable.description:
If this connection can be used by the importer watch system to periodically
check for new importable games
e.g.: Steam

userIdentifier.description:
A string representing a username, user id or profile URL for the target connection
e.g. a Steam's profile URL

totalPlaytimeSeconds.description: Total playtime for this game, in seconds.
Total playtime for this game, in seconds.
Total playtime for this game, in seconds.
Total playtime for this game, in seconds.

main.description: Average time (in seconds) to finish the game to its credits without spending notable time on extras such as side quests.

mainPlusSides.description: Average time (in seconds) to finish the game while mixing in some extras such as side quests without being overly thorough.

completionist.description: Average time (in seconds) to finish the game to 100% completion.

submitCount.description: Total amount of time to beat submissions for this game (in IGDB)

sourceId.description: Source identifier: UUID for content, positive integer for game

isLiked.description: Whether the source is currently liked by the user

likesCount.description: Current total like count for the source

ids.description:
If this is supplied, filtering will be done only for entities specified here.
Useful to filter data received from entities which hold game ids (like games and reviews).

viewId.description: Reuse this identity for retries of one navigation impression.

totalEstimatedPlaytime.description: Total playtime spent on games, based on available data import from user's connections.

reviewedCount.description: Number of items in period that have been reviewed. Not available to "playtime" criteria.

criteriaId.description:
Id of the criteria being used.
E.g. the id of a 'GameGenre' entity.

criteriaName.description:
Criteria being used as basis for this distribution.
E.g. The name of a 'GameGenre', the name of a Game's category (game, dlc, etc)

count.description:
Total number of times this criteria appears.
E.g. the number of games of 'adventure' genre a user has.

finishedCount.description:
Total number of items of this criteria that have been 'finished'. E.g. finished 'adventure' genre games.
Not avaiable in {@link ProfileMetricsTypeDistributionBy#STATUS}.

If the platinum trophy for this game is obtained, this will be true.
Not all games have a platinum trophy, and if a Platinum is obtained before a new achievement is added to the game,
there may be cases where the game is 'platinum' but not 'completed'.

If eligible, this will be true once the recap is created by the corresponding job.
